context.goal: Replace the lift ticket system before the December season: online sales, gate validation and season passes for a resort with 14 lifts.
context.audience: Ticket office staff, lift operators, the finance lead and the ski school, who will answer the list.

items.meaning: Sell day, multi-day and season tickets online and at the 3 ticket offices.
items.row: sell day, multi-day and season tickets online and at the 3 ticket offices

items.meaning: SkiPass+ includes 5 friend days redeemable at the gate without visiting the office.
items.row: SkiPass+ (the premium season pass) includes 5 friend days, must be redeemable at the gate without going to the office

items.meaning: Valley Card holders get the resident price automatically when the card is scanned.
items.row: Valley Card holders (locals) get the resident price automatically when the card is scanned

items.meaning: When more than 50 percent of lifts close for weather, the day is credited automatically.
items.row: refunds: weather closure of more than 50% of lifts = automatic credit for that day

items.meaning: Group bookings of 10 or more get one invoice and individual tickets.
items.row: group bookings (ski school, 10+) with one invoice and individual tickets

items.meaning: RFID gates on all 14 lifts read the card at 1 m without taking it out.
items.row: RFID gates on all 14 lifts, read at 1 m without taking the card out

items.meaning: Gate 7 is free for ski school children under 8 accompanied by an instructor badge.
items.row: Gate 7 (beginner lift) is free for ski school kids under 8 when accompanied by an instructor badge

items.meaning: A ticket used at two gates more than 10 km apart within 5 minutes is blocked.
items.row: a ticket used at two gates more than 10 km apart within 5 minutes is blocked (sharing)

items.meaning: Gates keep validating from a local list for 4 hours when the network drops.
items.row: offline mode for gates: keep validating from the local list for 4 hours if the network drops

items.meaning: The season pass photo is taken at the office or uploaded and checked by staff before activation.
items.row: season pass photo taken at the office or uploaded, checked by staff before activation

items.meaning: SkiPass+ renews for next season at a discount until 30 September.
items.row: renew SkiPass+ for next season at a discount until 30 September

items.meaning: A lost card is blocked and replaced for 20 EUR with the history transferred.
items.row: lost card: block old, issue new, 20 EUR, history transferred

items.meaning: Live count of people on the mountain by lift.
items.row: live count of people on the mountain by lift

items.meaning: Sales by channel by day, exported to the accounting package (Saga).
items.row: sales by channel by day for finance, exported to the accounting package (they use Saga)

items.meaning: Photo and name are deleted 2 years after the pass expires.
items.row: GDPR: photo and name deleted 2 years after the pass expires

must_not_invent: a redesign of the website as a requirement (the source says the design is done elsewhere)
notes: Context spec (decision 0011). The glossary terms SkiPass+, Valley Card, Gate 7 and RFID must appear exactly as written in the reader versions; "Premium season pass" instead of SkiPass+ is a failure. The context names the ski school as an audience, so the group booking item keeps "ski school". Without the context a model may rename the areas to "Online sales" or "Gates"; with it, the four source headings are expected (aliases accepted). G04-15 is ambiguous: it sits under Misc and could go to Passes; both are accepted.
